reuseFormula: Generate a black and white line art illustration. The central element is a circular frame containing a detailed portrait of a person. This circle is enclosed by a square border, which is composed of a repeating chain pattern and stylized roses at each corner and at the midpoints of the vertical sides. Above and to the left of the central circle, text is curved along its edge. Below and to the right of the central circle, another text element is placed horizontally. All elements should be rendered in solid black lines on a white background, with no shading or grayscale.
